rca of the issue: Iter17 RCA: RedeemDialog and FeedbackDialog were mounted twice (once in App.js globally, once in ExcelHeader.jsx locally). Both instances listened to the same global CustomEvent, so triggering 'open-redeem' opened both, and Playwright's .fill() targeted the wrong instance, leaving the visible dialog's Redeem button disabled. Iter18 fix removed the duplicate mounts + state from ExcelHeader and switched its menu buttons to dispatch CustomEvent, keeping the singleton in App.js. Verified: querySelectorAll('[data-testid=redeem-dialog]').length === 1 after triggering from both /hub tile and /app burger menu.
